summary: Tested the Unified Intent-Aware Search feature end-to-end. All 12 backend API tests passed (suggestions, person credits, intent, vibe with/without auth, TV movie details, TV streaming). Frontend tested via Playwright: title dropdown for 'inception' shows 8 suggestions and clicking opens MovieDetail; 'christopher nolan' surfaces 4 people; PersonDetail modal opens with Acting (24 credits) and Directing sections; clicking a credit closes PersonDetail and opens MovieDetail (media_type handled); TV show 'game of thrones' opens MovieDetail with correct title; free-text 'feeling nostalgic' + Enter shows vibe overlay with EXACTLY 5 cards and clear button correctly dismisses the overlay. Added missing data-testid attributes to dropdown items and person credit cards to enable robust automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: FeelingSearch.js is 693 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the dropdown, vibe overlay, and quick-prompts into subcomponents.
search/vibe endpoint caps at 5 via min(request.limit, 5) which silently ignores larger client limits; consider validating via Pydantic or documenting the cap.
Fallback branch in /search/vibe uses discover 'Popular pick that might match your mood' — could dilute AI intent; acceptable as safety net but log when it triggers.
